original_record.question:
Amelia built a crown using 10 copies of this piece <image1>. The parts were joined together so that the sides in contact had the same number, as shown in the picture, where four parts are visible. What is the number that appears in the colored triangle?
<image2>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.image1: one five-sector numbered pentagon with gray sector fills
inventory.image2: ten joined pentagons in crown; four lower/right pentagons show all five rotated digits and fills; six unnumbered; one upper-left outer sector pink

answer_verification.method: Regular pentagons share exact sides. Propagate cyclic numbers1..5 so both labels on every shared side agree; bottom shown piece seeds3,4,5,1,2 in local counterclockwise sector order. Propagated top-left outer sector is1.
